title: PushSubscription/set rejects fractional-second expires
description: RFC 8620 §1.4 (rfc8620.txt:346-347): 'the "time-secfrac" MUST always be omitted if zero', so a non-zero fraction such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00.5Z is a valid UTCDate. UTCDate::to_epoch_seconds (crate-jmap-types/src/id.rs) accepts only the 20-character ...SSZ form, so jmap-server PushSubscription/set (limit_expires in crate-jmap-server/src/push.rs, bd:JMAP-nbk3.3) answers invalidProperties ["expires"] for a valid fractional expires, and is_deliverable treats a stored fractional expires as expired (fails closed). The JMAP-nbk3 plan section 3 recorded the to_epoch_seconds limitation as pre-existing and out of scope. Fix options: make to_epoch_seconds accept and floor a time-secfrac, or truncate the fraction in limit_expires.
